oncall-bot: PagerDuty - HIGH: queue_backlog_exceeded for service=redwood-inference-autoscale (fired)

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/autoscale-backlog. Suggested initial actions: check scale-controller, nodepool quotas, and recent deploys.
jordan: acked PD. jumping in now. @maya_k @ashish_p can you p95-check and infra-counters? :raised_hand:
maya_k: looking. I see scale-controller heartbeats missing for the us-west-2 pool. Last heartbeat: 3m ago. Node provisioning backlog ~ 18 pending nodes in cloud provider.
ashish_p: checking cloud console — quota throttle on preemptible-spot pool, provider reporting "Insufficient resources" for n2-highmem in us-west-2.
ops-bot: Deploy timeline: no deploys in last 1h. Autoscaler config last changed 3d ago. KV-cache hitrate is normal.
jordan: initial mitigation: try manual scale of inference-runtime to relieve queues. Will run `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=20` if approved.
maya_k: approve. Do it. also lowering minNodeCount for burst is risky; prefer manual scale + enable fallback-model.
ashish_p: before scaling, confirm current HPA: ```bash
kubectl -n prod get hpa inference-runtime -o yaml
# metrics: cpu target 70, current 85
``` 
pods: ```
NAME                           READY STATUS   RESTARTS AGE
inference-runtime-abcde        0/1   Pending  0       12m
inference-runtime-fghij        1/1   Running  0       2h
``` 
jordan: running manual scale now.
ops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=20` (user=jordan)
oncall-bot: Scaling event detected. New desired replicas=20. Watch pods come up.
maya_k: new pods are pending for provisioning; cloud shows 6/18 nodes provisioned. Provisioning errors: `NodeCreationFailed: quota_exceeded`.
ashish_p: I'm opening a cloud support ticket; requesting burst capacity request. Link: https://console.cloud/req/BRST-9876
jordan: temporary workaround: enable fallbacks to smaller model (quantized-8) for non-enterprise routes to reduce resource pressure. Patching routing: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollouts -d '{ "route": "public-text-gen", "model": "q8-small", "pct": 40 }'`
maya_k: applying rollout 40% to q8-small for public-text-gen. Monitor error rate and quality regression. :eyes:
taylor_r: I'll take on-call after 20m. @jordan leave notes in the incident ticket and tag impacted customers.
jordan: notes: customer-impact: elevated latency and failed requests for some hosted customers in us-west-2 and dedicated tenants on reserved pools. SLO impacted: generation latency p95 > 3s; errors increased 5x for 1.2k requests. Created incident INC-2026-182 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-182)

ashish_p: cloud support accepted burst; new nodes expected within 6-10m. continuing to watch.

jordan: handing over to @taylor_r. I'll summarize in the ticket and include runbook steps taken. Please escalate to SRE lead if provisioning doesn't finish.
